title: Chapter 1302
text:
Hum!

At this time, the throne in the cabin suddenly flashed, and Han Xiao, wearing the King mechanical suit, appeared.

The helmet opened, revealing Han Xiao's face. His tone was curious.

He asked curiously, "What important discovery made you call me over?"

"You're a Mechanic Expert. Quickly take a look at that big guy outside." Aurora pointed outside the window.

In fact, there was no need for her to remind him. The moment Han Xiao asked the question, he noticed the abnormality of the environment. Following Aurora's finger, he saw this strange mechanical body.

"Yo, it's so big! A combination of living creatures and machinery. It's a bit like Cloak, but it doesn't seem to be the case … What is this? Where did you find it? "

With just a glance, Han Xiao was shocked.

He did not know what this thing was, but it looked many times larger than the normal size of his Mechanical Deity. It was covered in wounds, as if it had experienced all kinds of cosmic disasters.

"We suddenly encountered this. This space seems to be a sealed domain …"

Fuding explained the ins and outs from the side.

Han Xiao nodded, stroked his chin, and pondered.

"It sounds like this mechanical body has been maintaining a strange domain, and you accidentally broke in. If it's mechanical technology, it should be a high-level application of space technology, creating a constant folding field around the mechanical body, or changing some physical constants in this field. It's very high-end technology. "

"But the detection equipment of the spaceship didn't react." Aurora patted the console.

"Let me see …"

Han Xiao checked and found that the equipment was operating normally. His eyes flashed.

"Hmm, either the equipment was affected by virtual interference, or the other party has some kind of amazing concealment technology. No matter which it is, the technology is not ordinary …"

Aurora's spaceship had gathered a lot of technology from Jayz's technology treasure, but it was actually deceived at this time. Han Xiao immediately took it seriously.

"Could it be a Space Wonder phenomenon?" Fu Ding was curious.

"Don't jump to conclusions so early …" Han Xiao waved his hand and took the lead. "Since the spaceship can't retreat, let's try to get closer to this big guy."

"Are you sure?" Aurora was a little hesitant. "I sensed a weak life signal from it, but it didn't respond to any of my messages …"

"Is this big guy alive?"

Han Xiao stared blankly for a moment before his interest was piqued.

He was very familiar with Aurora's abilities, so he wouldn't make a mistake.

Originally, he had thought that this was the remains of a giant mechanical body that some civilization or Mechanic did not care about public morals and casually threw around. However, this mechanical body was alive, so things were a little interesting …

"Let's go and take a look."

Han Xiao only hesitated for two seconds before making a decision. He steered the spacecraft forward.

Sure enough, in this pitch-black domain, one could only advance and not retreat. The spaceship slowly approached its target.

The closer they got, the stronger the contrast in size. The detailed outline of the mechanical body was constantly magnified in their vision, making them feel small.

After a while, the spaceship stopped at a long and narrow hole on the mechanical body's finger. It was like a super-large cave that extended more than a thousand meters into the mechanical body.

The hatch opened, and the few of them walked out of the spaceship and stepped onto the rugged ground.

The flesh on the ground was entangled with the mechanical body, and one foot was hard while the other was soft. It was very uncomfortable to step on it.

Han Xiao squatted down, inserted his finger into a piece of flesh, and experienced the feeling. He then observed the muscles and veins and nodded.

"There are muscles, tendons, and fat. The texture looks like normal biological tissue, not artificial biochemical tendons …"

As he spoke, he exerted some force with his finger, and this piece of flesh actually oozed out a little blood.

Han Xiao looked up and saw that there were traces of dried blood around the flesh. It looked black and appeared to be sputtering like blood that had suddenly sprayed out from a slash.

His eyes flashed, and he suddenly thought of old Manison's Felon technology. This mechanical body was similar to the Felon's biological modification and biochemical prosthetics.

At this time, Fu Ding's voice suddenly sounded.

"Black Star, I'm not feeling well …"

Han Xiao and Aurora turned around and saw Fu Ding clutching his chest with a frown. He seemed to be in pain.

"What's wrong with you?"

Han Xiaoxin's heart tightened.

He reached out and poked Fu Ding, triggering the combat notification. After seeing it clearly, his expression changed slightly.

In Fu Ding's status bar, there was an additional negative status called [Dissolve]. The effect was to lose 0.01% to 0.5% of his Health, Energy, and Stamina every second. However, under the influence of his Luck Glow, he only suffered the weakest negative effect.

Why didn't I have such a reaction earlier? Could it be that this is the result of entering this body? '

Han Xiao's eyes narrowed, and he opened the interface to take a look. He realized that he did not have the [Dissolve] status, and there was not even a notification.

Does this effect only affect those below the Beyond Grade A realm? Is it limited to living beings or inanimate objects?

He turned around and looked at the spaceship parked at the side. After a simple inspection, he realized that the outer armor of the spaceship was showing signs of corrosion. The material used in this spaceship was extremely tough, and it was even mixed with a part of the Black Star Alloy, which had its own recovery ability. Even this was not immune to the [Dissolve] status …

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and had a guess in his heart.

This area can only be entered, not retreated. Regardless of whether it's living or inanimate objects, they will start to dissolve upon entering the mechanical body. It feels a bit like a trap like a Venus flytrap. Interesting. This is probably a trap drifting in the universe. Those who accidentally bump into it will not be able to escape and will become its nutrients …

Fortunately, there was a healer with sufficient healing power in the team. Otherwise, it would be slightly troublesome.

He signaled Aurora to heal Fu Ding while he took out a metal needle and pierced it deep into the flesh on the wall, trying to cause damage. If this big guy was an independent entity, the combat notification should be displayed.

Ding!

The next moment, the interface moved slightly, and a notification popped up.

Han Xiao opened it and his expression changed.

He saw that the level, species, and abilities of this mechanical body were all question marks. Only its name was not a question mark, but there was no difference. It was called [Unknown Aggregate].

This thing's level is actually so high?!

Even people like Manison and Sorokin, whose total level was higher than his, could only see a portion of their information. However, the information of this mechanical body was almost all question marks, which could only prove that the level difference was too great. In the current explored universe, Han Xiao estimated that only Wuornos had such a high level.

"What is the origin of this thing …"

Han Xiao's curiosity grew stronger.

There was indeed no impression of this mechanical body in his memories. Logically speaking, such a strange thing should not have been unknown in his previous life. He did not know if it had not been discovered or if it had been secretly hidden by someone.

Han Xiao did not have the time to care about Aurora and Han Xiao. He focused on studying. He tore off a lump of flesh from the ground and broke off a few mechanical parts. Then, he activated the matter detector on the mechanical suit and scanned and analyzed these two things.

Not long after, two analysis reports were out.

The first was the analysis results of the mechanical parts. It showed that the microstructure was very novel. There was no matching material in the database, which proved that the material of this mechanical body seemed to be some unknown alloy.

The second document was the analysis of the flesh. There was no matching biological gene, which proved that the source of the flesh was most likely not a known species in the explored universe. However, the existence of Super genes was detected from it, which was highly compatible with the Mechanic class. Although the cell activity was extremely weak, it seemed to still contain extremely weak electromagnetic energy.

Han Xiao tore off a lot of flesh for testing. Every piece had Super genes, and they were all cells of the Mechanic class.

"So, this flesh all came from a Mechanic …"

Han Xiao thought about the size of this mechanical body, and his face twitched slightly.

It would be fine if the flesh on the mechanical body was from the same person, but if it came from different individuals … how many Mechanic bodies would it take to build such a huge body?

"Should I try Explore?"

Han Xiao shook his head. He weighed the flesh in his hand, hesitated for a while, and activated (Bold Explorer).

This skill was useless on the character, but this mechanical body seemed to be different. A piece of flesh that had already been separated had a high chance of passing the test.

As he expected, the skill took effect the next moment.

Hum!

The world in front of Han Xiao suddenly changed, and scenes that he had never seen before flashed back.

It was as if a starry sky had opened up in front of him, and an incomparably glorious galactic civilization jumped into his eyes. Fleets swept through the starry sky, and their territory expanded outward. Planets turned into colonial areas, and cities rose up on desolate planets. Countless spaceships came and went between the planets. It was a prosperous scene, and it did not look inferior to a Universal Civilization.

However, at the very next moment, a wormhole that traversed space suddenly appeared. An unknown fleet that stretched as far as the eye could see invaded en masse, spilling the flames of war onto this peaceful civilization. Blood, slaughter, and screams replaced the prosperity that had been there before.

As the invaders advanced, illusory dark green roots extended out from the void and stabbed into the planets that fell into the hands of the invaders like straws. These planets melted, shrank, and withered at a speed visible to the naked eye. In the end, they all turned into liquid-like nutrients and were sucked away by the roots, leaving nothing behind.

"This is …"

Han Xiao's pupils constricted.

He was too familiar with this scene. It was like a replica of the World Tree War!

The invaders of this unknown civilization were the World Tree Civilization!

Before he could think further, the illusion in front of him changed, and he came to a cosmic space.

A large number of Mechanics were gathered there, sitting cross-legged in the starry sky. Behind them were their respective mechanical armies, forming a spectacular formation. Outside them were ring-shaped mechanical devices that covered this area.

A Mechanical Deity suddenly appeared in the middle of the crowd, releasing a strange energy wave that enveloped the entire area and resonated with the ring-shaped mechanical device.

All of a sudden, the bodies of all the Mechanics in the area exploded, turning into pure flesh and blood that mixed with their respective armies. Then, they turned into torrents that flowed into the Mechanical Deity in the center. This Mechanical Deity's body grew larger and larger until it finally became an enormous mechanical body. Its flesh and blood merged perfectly with the metal, and its appearance looked like a mechanical Biomass Giant that could support the heavens and the earth!

However, before Han Xiao could be surprised, the next second, the scene changed again. The enormous mechanical body that was still intact a second ago suddenly became tattered, as if it had experienced countless battles. Its appearance was very familiar. It was the mechanical body that Han Xiao and the others had encountered.

This damaged mechanical body seemed to have been scrapped. It lost all its power and slowly drifted in the universe. In the end, it was captured by a huge black hole and swallowed, disappearing without a trace.

At this moment, the view became macroscopic again. The territory of the unknown civilization had completely turned into darkness, almost cleaner than a desolate universe belt. There were no more stars.

The fleet of the World Tree Civilization was like a satisfied customer, retreating in satisfaction, leaving behind an empty, pitch-black universe.

This was the last scene of the illusion.

Han Xiao shuddered. The effect of the skill disappeared, and the illusion disappeared. His vision returned to normal.

There was still shock in his eyes as he muttered to himself, "Seems like something happened.

"It seems like we've discovered something incredible …."
